update_notes: 2026-03-29(full): DSP-3077 FDA Orphan Drug Designation取得（2026-03-23）、MCO-010 BLA継続中・新US特許取得（2026-01-05）、jCells Frontiers誌査読論文・Nature記事掲載、VG901/VeonGen VG801 ARVO 2026口頭発表予定、SPVN06 Nature Gene Therapy誌前臨床安全性論文。2026-03-23(full): SPVN06 PRODYGY 12ヶ月トップラインデータ発表・Phase 3準備開始、NPI-001 Phase 2/3確認試験開始（NCT07290530）、ZM-02 PRISM試験正式開始（2026-02-25）、DSP-3077 Trial ID追加（NCT06891885）・MEE観察研究完了、VG901社名変更（VeonGen Therapeutics）、jCells ARVO 2026発表見込み・Phase 3準備中。2026-03-12: OCU400 Phase 3 liMeliGhT登録完了（140名）・BLA Q3 2026、MCO-010スターガルトPhase 3計画追加、SPVN20新規追加

recent_updates.event: BLA rolling submissionは継続中（完全提出は2026年初頭予定）。FDA承認・CRLの発表は未確認。Ophthalmology TimesのQ2 2026パイプライン記事にMCO-010が掲載。新US特許取得（2026年1月5日）- MCO光遺伝学プラットフォームの知的財産保護を強化。BLA完全提出完了後、Priority Reviewにより6ヶ月以内の審査結果が期待される
ブランド名「MOGENRY」がFDA・EMA・PMDAで条件付き承認。BLA完全提出は2026年初頭予定で、Priority Reviewにより2026年中のFDA承認の可能性あり。地図状萎縮（GA）向けPhase 2を2026年開始予定（パイプライン拡大）。スターガルト病Phase 3も2026年開始予定
2026 Macula Society Annual Meeting (Feb 25-28, San Diego) でpost-hoc臨床分析データを発表予定。日本MHLWから先駆け指定（Sakigake）およびオーファン医薬品指定を取得（2026年1月21日）- 網膜遺伝子治療として初。先駆けは6ヶ月審査が目標。BLA rolling submission継続中、完全提出は2026年早期予定

BLA rolling submission in progress (started July 2025). Full submission expected early 2026 with priority review eligibility. ICER (April 2025) concluded evidence demonstrates net health benefit. EMA granted Orphan designations for 5 categories of retinal dystrophies. RMAT designation for Stargardt disease
5-year safety data and 3-year efficacy data show sustained vision gains. BLA expected to be completed in early 2026 with priority review eligibility
REMAIN study: Durable 3-year vision improvements with favorable safety profile
Initiated rolling BLA submission to FDA
RESTORE trial met primary endpoint with statistical significance

MCO-010.notes: First gene-agnostic gene therapy for RP (sonpiretigene isteparvovec / brand name: MOGENRY). Uses AAV2 vector to deliver multi-characteristic opsin (MCO) to bipolar retinal cells via intravitreal injection. BLA rolling submission ongoing, full submission expected early 2026. New US patent granted Jan 5, 2026 for MCO platform. Eligible for priority review (6-month review after BLA acceptance) - potential FDA approval in 2026. One-time in-office injection for severe vision loss. ICER (April 2025) concluded evidence adequately demonstrates net health benefit. STARLIGHT Phase 2 positive for Stargardt disease; Phase 3 registrational trial planned for 2026. Geographic atrophy (GA) Phase 2 also planned for 2026. Japan MHLW granted Sakigake (Pioneer) and Orphan Drug designations (Jan 2026) - first retinal gene therapy to receive both, enabling accelerated 6-month review in Japan. Brand name MOGENRY conditionally approved by FDA, EMA, and PMDA.

OCU400.status: Enrollment completed - BLA rolling submission Q3 2026

recent_updates.event: 韓国Kwangdong Pharmaceutical社とライセンス契約締結。韓国における開発・商業化の独占権を付与。初の地域パートナーシップ。キャッシュランウェイは2026年Q4まで。株価は年初来75%上昇

Phase 3 liMeliGhT試験の登録完了を発表（2026年3月2日）。140名をランダム化（2:1で治療群と未治療対照群、RHOアームとgene-agnosticアーム）。小児（3歳以上）も含む。BLA rolling submission Q3 2026予定。1年試験のため、トップラインデータはQ1 2027。3年間Phase 1/2データ: 88%(7/8)の評価可能患者で改善/維持、約2ライン(LLVA)改善
Phase 3 liMeliGhT試験は予定通り進行中。BLA rolling submission H1 2026開始予定。150名（RHO 75名+gene-agnostic 75名）、カナダ50名追加。Phase 1/2の2年データで100%(9/9)改善/維持。Expanded Access Program承認済み（米国75名）
Phase 1/2 2-year data: 100% (9/9) patients improved or maintained vision
First patient dosed in Phase 3 liMeliGhT trial

OCU400.notes: Targets 100+ gene mutations. Phase 3 liMeliGhT enrollment completed March 2, 2026 (140 patients, 2:1 randomized, including pediatrics 3+). 3-year Phase 1/2 data: 88% improvement/preservation with ~2-line LLVA gain. Expanded Access Program in US (75 patients) and Canada (50 patients). BLA rolling submission Q3 2026, topline data Q1 2027, potential approval 2027. Korea license agreement with Kwangdong Pharmaceutical (first regional partner). Cash runway through Q4 2026.

VP-001.status: Completed Phase 1/2 - Registrational trial start delayed to by CY2030

recent_updates.event: 2026年2月に$653M（6億5300万ドル）の大型資金調達を完了。登録試験開始はCY2030までと発表資料に記載（従来の2025年後半予定から大幅遅延）。PYC公式サイトでは「Phase 1臨床試験の登録は終了。将来の試験を計画中」と記載。DINGO延長試験で一部患者に継続投与中。30μgが治療効果のある最小用量として特定

Phase 2/3 registrational study design finalized after FDA alignment meeting (Dec 2025). FDA confirmed sham control arm and inclusion/exclusion criteria acceptable. Phase 1/2 results (PLATYPUS 12名, WALLABY 6名): LLVA改善、微小視野改善を確認
Positive FDA meeting to finalize Phase 2/3 registrational study design
Positive Phase 1/2 results presented at ARVO: LLVA improvements, microperimetry improvements in 18 patients (PLATYPUS 12, WALLABY 6)
Received FDA Rare Pediatric Disease (RPD) designation

VP-001.notes: First therapy specifically for RP11. Positive Phase 1/2 results with vision improvements (LLVA, microperimetry) in 18 patients across 4 dose levels (3, 10, 30, 75 μg). 30μg identified as minimum effective dose. RPD designation makes it eligible for Priority Review Voucher (PRV) worth $100M+ if approved. FDA alignment meeting confirmed trial design for Phase 2/3. However, registrational trial start delayed significantly to by CY2030 (previously 2025-H2). $653M capital raise in Feb 2026 secures funding through 2030. DINGO extension study ongoing for select patients.

AGTC-501.status: Enrollment completed - 12-month topline data expected H2 2026

recent_updates.event: VISTA試験登録完了（85名、12-50歳男性、XLRP確定診断）。12ヶ月トップラインデータ2026年H2予定。LANDSCAPE試験開始（2025年12月、両眼投与安全性評価）。EURETINA 2025でDAWN 9+ヶ月データとSKYLINE 36ヶ月データ発表 - 持続的な視覚機能改善を確認。laru-zova（AGTC-501）として正式名称化
Phase 2/3 VISTA trial enrollment completed (85 participants). 12-month topline data expected in H2 2026
Received FDA RMAT designation. Phase 2 SKYLINE trial 12-month data: 63% responder rate. DAWN trial: second eye treatment showed mean 16-letter improvement. $170M Series B funding completed
Phase 2 DAWN trial: 6-month interim data positive
Phase 2/3 VISTA trial initiated

AGTC-501.notes: Targets X-linked RP (laru-zova/AGTC-501). VISTA trial enrollment completed with 85 participants. Multiple positive Phase 2 trials (SKYLINE 36-month, DAWN 9+ month). LANDSCAPE trial evaluating bilateral dosing safety. RMAT, Fast Track, UK ILAP, and EU PRIME designations.

recent_updates.event: FDA Orphan Drug Designation取得（2026年1月22日）。CLARICO Phase 1/2a試験進行中。Phase 1: 用量漸増デザイン（4コホート、12-24名の法的失明患者）。Phase 2: 追加安全性・視覚機能評価（最大15名）。合計約54名登録予定
FDA Fast Track Designation granted Feb 27, 2025. First patient dosed July 8, 2025 in Phase 1/2a CLARICO trial (NCT06789445). Trial aims to enroll 54 participants to assess safety and outcomes
First patient treated in CLARICO trial - world's first iPSC-derived cell therapy tested in humans for primary photoreceptor diseases

OpCT-001.notes: iPSC-derived photoreceptor cells by BlueRock Therapeutics (Bayer subsidiary) in partnership with FUJIFILM Cellular Dynamics. World's first iPSC-derived cell therapy for primary photoreceptor diseases. Phase 1: dose escalation (12-24 legally blind patients across 4 cohorts). Phase 2: up to 30 participants across 2 cohorts evaluating 2 dose levels. FDA Fast Track + Orphan Drug Designation. Initial safety and preliminary efficacy data expected H2 2026 to 2027.

recent_updates.event: Phase 2/3確認試験（NCT07290530）が2026年初頭に開始。24ヶ月間のランダム化二重盲検試験。主要評価項目: EZ Area変化（光受容体保護）。Usher症候群関連RP患者を対象。承認申請は良好な結果が得られれば2028年頃を見込む
FDA Breakthrough Therapy指定取得。Phase 1/2試験（49名、2年間）で陽性データ：視覚機能喪失を約30%遅延、光受容体喪失を50%以上抑制（Usher症候群関連RP）。統計的有意性は未達だが臨床的に意味のある改善。2026年に確認的試験開始予定
Positive Phase 1/2 data: 49 patients over 2 years showed ~30% slower visual function loss and >50% reduction in photoreceptor loss vs placebo in USH-associated RP
Received FDA Fast Track designation

NPI-001.notes: Oral neuroprotective therapy (N-acetylcysteine amide/NACA, 500mg BID). FDA Breakthrough Therapy (Oct 2025) + Fast Track + Orphan Drug designations. Phase 1/2 showed ~30% slower visual function loss in USH-associated RP, >50% reduction in photoreceptor loss. Phase 2/3 confirmatory trial (NCT07290530) started early 2026: 24-month randomized double-blind trial, primary endpoint EZ Area change. If successful, NDA filing expected around 2028. First oral therapy for RP.

recent_updates.event: 慶應大学・名古屋工大共同研究による光遺伝学治療。RV-001としてRestore Vision社が開発。AAVベクターでキメラロドプシン遺伝子を硝子体注射。低光量でも反応可能な高感度が特徴。1回投与で半永久的効果が期待。国内初の光遺伝学臨床応用
First gene therapy trial for RP in Japan initiated
First patient dosed at Keio University Hospital

Keio_Optogenetics.notes: Targets completely blind RP patients. First RP gene therapy trial in Japan. Treatment designated as RV-001 by Restore Vision Inc. (Keio University spin-off). Uses chimeric channelrhodopsin with high sensitivity enabling vision even under low light conditions. Single administration expected to provide semi-permanent effect regardless of RP genotype. Planning to enroll 6-15 severe patients with 6-month follow-up.

CTx-PDE6b.notes: Targets specific PDE6B mutations causing RP

SPVN06.status: PRODYGY 12-month topline data released - Phase 3 preparation underway

recent_updates.event: Nature Gene Therapy誌に前臨床安全性・体内分布論文「Preclinical safety and biodistribution of SPVN06」が掲載。H1 2026のカンファレンス参加予定を発表（SparingVision公式サイト）。PRODYGY試験データの規制当局との共有が2026年中に進行中
PRODYGY試験12ヶ月トップラインデータ発表。全用量で忍容性良好・SAEなし。網膜構造維持（視細胞層厚み）と視機能（微細視野感度）でプラセボ群比較でポジティブな傾向確認。FDA/EMAとの規制当局協議を開始。Phase 3（ピボタル試験）を2026年後半〜2027年初頭に開始計画
初期有効性シグナル確認: Phase 1の最初の6名（低・中用量）のうち3名で、2つの連続する時点（6ヶ月間隔）でBCVA改善を確認。2026年中に規制当局とデータ共有を開始予定。AI/機械学習ツールを統計解析と並行して使用し、ピボタル試験の最適なエンドポイント・患者集団の選定を行う予定
PRODYGY Phase 1/2試験の患者投与を完了（2026年2月9日発表）。合計33名登録（SPVN06投与27名 + 対照群6名、2023年4月から投与開始）。初回データ読出しは2027年予定。2026年中に規制当局とのデータ共有を開始し、2027年にピボタル試験開始を目指す。RdCVF/RdCVFLを送達し、遺伝子変異に依存せず光受容体機能を維持

PRODYGY Phase 1/2 trial progressing well. Dose escalation (Step 1) completed Oct 2024. Controlled, randomized extension phase (Step 2) started Q4 2024. Favorable safety profile through 18 months: no SAEs, no DLTs, no discontinuations

SPVN06.notes: Gene-agnostic gene therapy for RP delivering RdCVF and RdCVFL via AAV to sustain photoreceptor function. PRODYGY trial dosing completed (33 patients: 27 treated + 6 control). 12-month topline data (Q1 2026): favorable safety across all doses (no SAEs), positive trends in retinal structure preservation and microperimetry sensitivity vs placebo. Initial efficacy signals: 3/6 Phase 1 patients showed BCVA improvement. FDA/EMA regulatory discussions initiated. Phase 3 (pivotal trial) planned late 2026/early 2027. US IND approved.

SPVN20.status: NYRVANA trial - Dose escalation in progress

recent_updates.event: NYRVANA Phase 1/2試験で初患者投与（2025年10月）。進行したRP患者の休眠錐体細胞を再活性化し、視力と色覚を回復する遺伝子非特異的治療。硝子体内AAV注射、単回投与。ベルギーで開始、フランス・アイルランドに拡大予定。2026年に米国での試験許可取得を目指す。オープンラベル、多施設、用量漸増試験。6ヶ月評価+5年長期フォローアップ

SPVN20.notes: SparingVision's second gene therapy program (after SPVN06). Gene-agnostic intravitreal AAV therapy designed to restore cone vision in advanced RP by reactivating dormant cone photoreceptors using GIRK channel gene. NYRVANA Phase 1/2 first-in-human trial: open-label, multicenter, dose-escalation study. Dose-escalation ongoing in Belgium, France, Ireland. US IND filing planned 2026. Initial safety data expected H2 2026. 6-month evaluation + 5-year long-term follow-up.

recent_updates.event: LUNA Phase 2b試験進行中。2年間の二重盲検、ランダム化、シャム対照試験。81名登録予定（8歳以上）。USH2A遺伝子エクソン13変異によるRP/Usher症候群2A型が対象。西洋で約16,000人が対象変異を持つと推定。米国・英国・オランダで実施
First patient dosed in Phase 2b LUNA trial at Retina Foundation of the Southwest, Dallas

Ultevursen.notes: Targets Usher syndrome type 2A and RP with USH2A exon 13 mutations. Antisense oligonucleotide (AON) injected intravitreally to mask disease mutation in RNA via exon skipping. 2-year double-masked, randomized, sham-controlled trial (NCT06627179) with 81 participants ages 8+. Dosing schedule: 4 IVT injections over 2 years (day 0, month 6, 12, 18). ~16,000 affected patients estimated in Western world. Data readout expected H2 2026 to 2027. Developed by Sepul Bio (Théa subsidiary, acquired from ProQR 2023).

Botaretigene sparoparvovec.status: XLRP development stalled - Focus shifted to GA (PARASOL trial)

recent_updates.event: XLRP開発は事実上停滞。2026年J&J優先パイプラインにXLRP適応は含まれず。長期安全性試験（NCT04794101）が2025年9月に早期完了（プログラム整理の兆候）。同一プラットフォームで地図状萎縮（GA）向けPARASOL Phase 2b試験の主要試験期間が2026年2月23日に完了。2026年後半にARVO等での発表が期待。XLRP副次評価項目では40%の患者が2つ以上の視機能指標で改善を示した（対照群0%）
Phase 3 LUMEOS trial failed to meet primary endpoint (VMA at 52 weeks)

Botaretigene sparoparvovec.notes: XLRP Phase 3 LUMEOS failed primary endpoint (VMA) but 40% of treated patients improved on 2+ secondary visual endpoints (vs 0% control). J&J described results as 'directionally supportive'. XLRP development stalled; BLA plans cancelled. Long-term safety study (NCT04794101) completed early Sept 2025. Same platform being used for geographic atrophy (GA) PARASOL Phase 2b trial (primary completion Feb 2026). XLRP not in J&J 2026 priority pipeline.

VG901.status: High-dose cohort evaluation - Final analysis expected

recent_updates.event: VG801（スターガルト病向け遺伝子治療）のARVO 2026口頭発表を予定。同社のパイプライン拡大を示す。VG901（RP向け）のPhase 1b高用量コホート評価は継続中。VG801にもFDA RPDD指定取得
社名をViGeneronからVeonGen Therapeuticsに変更（2025年6月）。Phase 1b高用量コホート評価中。最終解析結果の発表またはPhase 2/3移行準備段階。CNGA1変異RPに対する世界唯一の臨床段階治療法
Phase 1b試験進行中。用量漸増第2段階に進行（DSMB承認済み）。初回コホートでDLT報告なし。RPDD指定によりPRV取得可能。EMAがCTA（臨床試験申請）を承認。テュービンゲン大学（ドイツ）で実施
FDA granted Rare Pediatric Disease Designation (RPDD). DSMB unanimously approved dose escalation in ongoing Phase 1b trial
First patient dosed in Phase 1b trial

VG901.notes: Gene therapy for RP caused by CNGA1 mutations. Company renamed from ViGeneron to VeonGen Therapeutics (June 2025). Uses proprietary next-generation vgAAV capsid for intravitreal delivery of functional CNGA1 gene to photoreceptors. Trial conducted at University of Tübingen. High-dose cohort evaluation in progress, final analysis expected. RPDD makes it eligible for Priority Review Voucher if approved. EMA CTA approved for EU trial. Only clinical-stage therapy for CNGA1 RP worldwide.

ZM-02.status: PRISM trial officially started - Enrolling in US and China

recent_updates.event: PRISM試験が2026年2月25日に正式開始（ClinicalTrials.gov登録）。前向き・無作為化・シャム対照・用量漸増試験。米中複数施設で実施。成人および小児が対象。評価項目: 安全性、MLMT（多輝度移動テスト）、形状識別。主要完了2029年12月、全体完了2031年12月予定。色覚回復能力が他の光遺伝学療法との差別化要因
MOON試験（初ヒト試験）の詳細データ: 36週時点で83%の患者にBCVA ≥0.3 LogMAR改善、平均0.59 LogMAR改善。多輝度移動テストで低照度ナビゲーション能力回復。色覚回復も確認。52週時点で持続性を確認。薬物関連SAEなし、DLTなし。PRISM試験（NCT07282457）: 多施設ランダム化シャム対照用量漸増Phase 1/2、米中両国で実施
FDA cleared IND application for ZM-02, enabling multinational Phase 1/2 PRISM trial
Received FDA Orphan Drug Designation

ZM-02.notes: Gene-agnostic optogenetic therapy using AAV to deliver PsCatCh2.0e channelrhodopsin to retinal ganglion/bipolar cells. Unique ability to restore color vision (unlike other optogenetic approaches). MOON trial (first-in-human, China): 83% BCVA improvement at 36 weeks, mean 0.59 LogMAR gain, durability at 52 weeks, no SAEs. PRISM trial officially started Feb 25, 2026: prospective randomized sham-controlled dose-escalation in US and China. Primary completion Dec 2029, full completion Dec 2031.

jCells.status: JC02-88 trial ongoing - Data expected at ARVO 2026 (May)

recent_updates.event: Frontiers in Cellular Neuroscience誌に「Retinal progenitor cells (jCell) for retinitis pigmentosa」の査読論文が掲載（PubMed ID: 40927136）。Nature誌にも「First-in-class cell therapy shows promise in patients with progressive vision loss」の記事掲載。JC02-88中間結果はQ1 2026予定だが正式発表は未確認。ARVO 2026（5月）での発表が有力

JC02-88試験のデータ集積・解析中。正式な中間解析プレスリリースは未発行（Q1 2026目標）。ARVO 2026（2026年5月）での発表が有力視。Phase 2b試験での高用量群（300万細胞）で平均+16.27文字改善の既存データを基に、Phase 3ピボタル試験の設計・準備を並行して進行中。Frontiers in Cellular Neuroscience誌で高用量群12ヶ月データ（平均+9.0文字改善）を発表済み
JC02-88 Phase 2試験進行中。2026年Q1に中間結果予定。主要評価項目: ETDRS 15文字以上の視力改善。880万細胞の単回硝子体内注射（従来最高用量の約50%増）。最大60名（18-60歳、遺伝子型不問）。全患者UCアーバイン・ガビンハーバート眼科研究所で治療。シャム群は延長試験で治療を受ける資格あり
First patients treated in JC02-88 trial
JC02-88 Phase 2 trial officially started

jCells.notes: Cell-based therapy (famzeletcel) for RP regardless of causative gene mutation. RMAT designation granted. Previous Phase 2b: high-dose group +16.27 letters, published in Frontiers in Cellular Neuroscience (12-month: +9.0 letters). JC02-88 tests higher dose (8.8M cells) in sham-controlled design. Primary endpoint: ≥15 ETDRS letter improvement. Data expected at ARVO 2026 (May). Phase 3 pivotal trial design and preparation underway.

DSP-3077.status: Phase 1/2 trial in progress - FDA Orphan Drug Designation granted

recent_updates.event: FDA Orphan Drug Designation取得（2026年3月23日発表）。オーファン指定により臨床試験費用の税額控除、FDAユーザーフィー免除、承認後7年間の市場独占権が付与。住友ファーマとしては過去1年で4件目のFDA Orphan Drug Designation取得。Phase 1/2試験（NCT06891885）進行中
recent_updates.source: Company PR (prnewswire.com), Foundation Fighting Blindness, CheckOrphan, Ophthalmology Times

recent_updates.event: 住友ファーマR&D説明会（2026年2月17日）: 米国Phase 1/2試験（NCT06891885）進行中。FY2025内（2026年3月末まで）の第1症例移植開始を目標。MEEでの観察研究（NCT06517940）が2026年2月末に完了、エンドポイント最適化に活用。移植後最大15年間の長期安全性モニタリングを計画。神戸アイセンターでは「ひも状」iPS網膜細胞移植の新臨床研究が2025年12月に厚労省承認
他家iPS細胞由来網膜シート（DSP-3077）の米国Phase 1/2試験IND承認。Massachusetts Eye and Earと協力。2020年開始の神戸アイセンター病院での臨床研究では移植後2年間の生着・安全性確認済み。新鮮（非凍結）3D組織/オルガノイドを使用。2025年度中の患者移植開始を目指す

DSP-3077.notes: Allogeneic iPSC-derived retinal sheet (3D organoid) for RP. FDA Orphan Drug Designation granted March 23, 2026 (tax credits, fee exemption, 7-year market exclusivity). Kobe City Eye Hospital confirmed 2-year engraftment and safety in clinical research (started 2020). US Phase 1/2 (NCT06891885) at Massachusetts Eye and Ear, first transplant planned by end of FY2025 (March 2026). MEE observational study (NCT06517940) completed Feb 2026 for endpoint optimization. 15-year long-term safety monitoring planned. Kobe Eye Center also approved new 'string-shaped' iPSC retinal cell transplant clinical research (Dec 2025 MHLW approval). Uses fresh non-frozen 3D tissue. Building on pioneering Japanese iPS cell retinal sheet technology.
